stories.title: Nonlinear optical lattice boosts spatial coherence by concentrating light in a single mode
stories.desc: Light waves can have varying degrees of coherence, which means that the consistency of the relationship between their phases across space or time can differ. Reliable methods to enhance the coherence of light could pave the way for the development of high-quality lasers and scientific instruments.
